integrity_note: The proof is analytic and finite tests are supporting evidence, not an infinite certificate. The exact finite fan support law is distinguished from known wheel avalanche polynomials and known fan recurrence counts; historical priority remains provisional.
limitations: Uniform unweighted fan with the dominating vertex as sink; one-grain drive; uniform recurrent law. Bulk law requires the site receding from both ends. No claim of critical power-law scaling, random toppling, multiple sinks or weighted edges.
title: Fibonacci factorization of driven sandpile avalanches on fan graphs
